title: Proposing Better Rollouts for On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.36477v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves language-model post-training by letting the student learn from its own sampled trajectories under teacher supervision, aligning the training process with inference-time behavior. However, the rollout policy in OPD is usually treated as fixed: each round samples directly from the current student. We show that this choice can create a compounding teacher--student mismatch, because it requires the teacher to provide effective supervision on whichever trajectories the student samples, including ones less reachable by the teacher itself. On such trajectories, teacher supervision can become noisy or even misleading, leading to undesirable student patterns such as repetition. Moreover, since the updated student in turn defines the rollout policy of subsequent rounds, these patterns persist and potentially amplify over training. translated_title: 为在线策略蒸馏提出更好的轨迹采样方法
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（On-policy distillation, OPD）通过让学生模型在教师模型的监督下从自身采样的轨迹中学习，从而改进语言模型的后训练，使训练过程与推理时的行为保持一致。然而，OPD 中的 rollout 策略通常被视为固定的：每一轮都直接从当前的学生模型进行采样。我们证明这种选择会造成教师与学生之间错位的不断累积，因为它要求教师能够对学生采样到的任意轨迹（包括教师自身难以到达的轨迹）提供有效监督。在这类轨迹上，教师的监督可能变得嘈杂甚至具有误导性，导致学生出现重复等不良生成模式。此外，由于更新后的学生模型又会定义后续轮次的 rollout 策略，这些不良模式会在训练过程中持续存在并可能不断放大。这一失败模式表明，改进 OPD 需要将 rollout 策略（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文揭示在线策略蒸馏中固定以学生模型作为 rollout 策略会导致教师-学生错位不断累积并引发重复等退化行为，并据此提出更好的 rollout 策略设计以提升蒸馏效果。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the fixed student-as-rollout-policy choice in on-policy distillation creates a compounding teacher-student mismatch that leads to degenerate behaviors like repetition, and proposes better rollout strategies to improve OPD.
